definitions.gloss: adding points; bonus points; extra credit
definitions.explanation: The act of adding points to a score, grade, or evaluation. Used in educational, sports, and competitive contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦ボーナス→ボーナス：05878_boonasu⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{加点|かてん}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Extra points are added for the bonus question.

examples.japanese: ⟦{出席率|しゅっせきりつ}→出席率：16604_shussekiritsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{加点|かてん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Students with high attendance get bonus points.

examples.japanese: ⟦{面接|めんせつ}→面接：01100_mensetsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{印象|いんしょう}→印象：01846_inshou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{良|よ}ければ→良い：02350_yoi⟧、⟦{採点|さいてん}→採点：04160_saiten⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{加点|かてん}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧こと⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: If the impression during the interview is good, bonus points may be added to the score.

notes:
USAGE:
Used as a suru-verb ({加点|かてん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧). Common in education (grading, exams) and sports (scoring). The opposite is ⟦{減点|げんてん}→減点：16413_genten⟧ (point deduction).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {加点|かてん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to add points)
- {加点|かてん}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧ (to have points added)
- {加点|かてん}⟦{方式|ほうしき}→方式：05454_houshiki⟧ (additive scoring system)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{減点|げんてん}→減点：16413_genten⟧: deduction of points — the opposite, subtracting points for errors
- ⟦{得点|とくてん}→得点：04909_tokuten⟧: score, points earned — the total points one has obtained
